ios.desc:
BuddyAid is your all-in-one service marketplace where service receivers and providers connect instantly. Whether you’re looking for household cleaning, a painter, a music tutor, or a trusted professional for urgent work, BuddyAid makes it fast, secure, and effortless. 
No need to waste your time endlessly searching for reliable help. BuddyAid brings together people who need a service and skilled providers who are ready to deliver on demand. And the main twist, you get paid based on the reviews of delivered services. 

Search by your pincode, select the service you want, choose the date, and tick the box if tools are required.    

Why Choose BuddyAid?
For Service Seekers: Start by logging in, select a service request, choose a date, add required tools, and get matched with skilled helpers nearby. Review ratings and feedback to hire confidently.
For Service Providers: Start by creating your profile, listing your expertise, and start earning by accepting tasks that fit your skills. You can also increase your earnings based on the reviews and stars received from the consumers.  
Features You’ll Love
Seamless Search & Booking
BuddyAid helps you to easily find the right service provider through its intuitive search and booking system. You just need to enter your location, select the required service, and get instant results. You can also book immediate services or schedule them for later. 
Transparent Pricing
There are no hidden fees or guess pricing system on BuddyAid. The service provider and receiver can both see the pricing, which helps in maintaining transparency for the users. This transparency also helps in building trust and allows you to easily compare different service providers.   
Ratings & Reviews
You can choose the best service providers by browsing through honest ratings and reviews from other users. Each of the service providers goes through an evaluation process by real clients, which ensures that you can see past performance and reliability before booking. 
Secure Payments
BuddyAid guarantees that your transactions are simple, safe, and hassle-free. The service providers receive the payment through the app once the service is completed, which eliminates the risk of unsafe exchanges. 
Flexibility
There is no strict schedule for BuddyAid. You can easily choose between one-time tasks, recurring services, or long-term support based on your needs and demands.

quotes.text:
Show HN:My name is Anuja and I’m the  founder of BuddyAid.

Close to COVID, I lost my job as a software developer and struggled to find new opportunities. As a certified artist, I started teaching pencil drawing/Art to neighborhood kids at a low cost, which my neighbors wanted often due to its affordability and convenience.Soon after this,a Henna artist who was a block away from me was interested in teaching henna art and  a college student who was a pet sitter came-in to market their service.and so we hosted an event in the garage which quickly became a big hit.

Here jobseeker can choose theirarea of interest which can be one of 20+ categories like Baking,Cooking,Art,Guitarist,Gardening,Cleaning Etc and start working for neighbors. We track job seekers' locations, offer online payments via Stripe, and use SMS for efficient communication . We earn a commission on successful job completions and pay our workforce based on ratings and reviews.
For iOS users:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/buddyaid/id1621508939
